name: Coconut milk
description: Pressed from grated coconut — the body of southern curries and the base of payasam.

tcm.note: Read with coconut; not a classical Chinese entry.

ayurveda.note: Narikela is shita, guru and snigdha — cooling and heavy.

unani.note: Thanda-tar; the coastal counter to garam cooking.

histamine.note: Low fresh or tinned; it sours quickly once opened.

ref.as: coconut, coconut shavings, coconut milk, coconut water

nutrition.highlight: the body of a southern curry
